claims: Konnor Griffin graduated from Jackson Preparatory School in Flowood, Mississippi, in 2024.
Konnor Griffin led the Patriots to multiple state championships.
Konnor Griffin was selected 9th overall by the Pittsburgh Pirates in the 2024 MLB Draft.
Konnor Griffin began his professional career after being selected in the 2024 MLB Draft.
Konnor Griffin's positions were shortstop, center fielder, and pitcher.
In his 2024 senior season, Konnor Griffin batted .559.
In his 2024 senior season, Konnor Griffin hit 9 home runs.
In his 2024 senior season, Konnor Griffin had 39 RBI.
In his 2024 senior season, Konnor Griffin stole 85 bases.
In his senior year, Konnor Griffin finished 10-0 as a pitcher.
In his senior year, Konnor Griffin had a 0.72 ERA as a pitcher.
In his senior year, Konnor Griffin recorded 107 strikeouts as a pitcher.
Konnor Griffin was named the 2023-24 Gatorade National Baseball Player of the Year.
Konnor Griffin reclassified from the 2025 class to the 2024 class.
Konnor Griffin originally committed to play for LSU.
Konnor Griffin signed with the Pittsburgh Pirates.
